draw:text-box.text:p: TMC Process Modules
A project-aligned flow from upload and preparation to split, total market calculation, restatement, and validation.
Source matrix, reporter list, brand mapping, group country, OTH, and CRP uploads.
Merge TMA and SAL, prepare CRP-ready fields, and generate the raw base.
Calculate prepared TMA, Volvo CE, and non-Volvo CE measures.
Summarize prepared rows into adjustment-ready output for review.
Apply machine-line split logic to OTH and adjustment outputs.
Delete double brand, calculate total market, and run restatement balancing.
Validation compares the resulting output by country, artificial machine line, and size class before business sign-off.
Key project pages already reflect this flow: Matrix Submission, Upload OTH / CRP, Pipeline Viewer, Total Market Calculation, Restatement, and TMC Validation Report.
System Architecture and Development Stack
The implementation combines a browser UI, FastAPI services, PostgreSQL storage, and automated cloud deployment.
Frontend URL: https://thesis-rust-five.vercel.app/
Repository: https://github.com/YanxiangDu2023/thesis
This structure keeps interface, business logic, storage, and deployment concerns clearly separated.
Main Tables and Stored Data
The database is organized around upload history, reference mappings, source datasets, manual adjustments, and generated report snapshots.
This schema supports both operational use and auditability: each upload, calculation, and snapshot can be traced back to a planning year and a specific source run.
Frontend-Backend Interaction Model
The UI triggers API calls, the backend executes business logic, and the response is rendered back into tables, reports, and pipeline views.

text:p.text:span: latest upload rows, report snapshots, validation summaries, downloadable outputs

draw:text-box.text:p: This interaction pattern lets the frontend stay focused on user experience while the backend centralizes calculation, validation, persistence, and report generation logic.
Deployment, Trust, and Automatic Release
The backend is deployed automatically from GitHub to Google Cloud Run through a trusted GitHub Actions workflow.

text:p.text:span: Google Cloud trusts the workflow identity, not a personal GitHub login.

draw:text-box.text:p: Practical sequence: push code -> GitHub Actions authenticates with Workload Identity Federation -> build and push image -> deploy Cloud Run -> backend connects to Cloud SQL.
Cloud Run Cost and Remaining Work
The current cloud setup is practical for a thesis prototype, but cost and unfinished business rules still need attention.
